description: We are a driven team of STEM students in the NASA Space Apps Challenge, passionate about space tech, Earth observation, and data science. Our project harmonizes satellite hotspot data (MODIS & VIIRS) for actionable thermal monitoring and wildfire detection. Join us to build an impactful solution in an energetic, collaborative environment! We’re looking for teammates skilled in Python, geospatial data, research, UI/UX, or presentation design to bring this vision to life.
